items.text: Although online services save time, people who need detailed advice may still prefer speaking to a person.
items.prompt: 主句的核心判断是什么？

choices.label: 需要详细建议的人仍可能更愿意与真人交谈
choices.why: Although 从句是让步背景，主句从 people 开始。

choices.label: 在线服务从来不能节省时间
choices.why: 让步从句明确承认能节省时间。

choices.label: 所有人都拒绝使用在线服务
choices.why: 原句只限定 people who need detailed advice，且使用 may。

items.text: The council rejected the company’s first proposal because it did not explain how local residents would benefit.

choices.label: the company’s first proposal
choices.why: 能“解释居民如何受益”的应是 proposal。

choices.label: the council
choices.why: council 虽是单数，但语义上被拒绝的提案才缺少说明。

choices.label: local residents
choices.why: residents 是复数，应使用 they。

items.text: The new system reduced waiting times; however, it also made simple requests harder to complete.
items.prompt: 作者对新系统的态度是什么？

choices.label: 承认效率改善，同时指出新的代价
choices.why: however 把积极结果和负面代价并置。

choices.label: 认为等待时间变得更长
choices.why: reduced waiting times 是缩短等待。

items.text: What makes the service valuable is not the amount of information it provides, but the care with which that information is selected.
items.prompt: 哪项翻译最准确地保留了 not...but... 的重心？

choices.label: 这项服务的价值不在于它提供了多少信息，而在于这些信息经过了多么认真的筛选。
choices.why: 准确保留了价值判断、否定项和强调项。

choices.label: 这项服务没有提供信息，所以必须认真选择。
choices.why: 原文并未否认提供信息。

choices.label: 信息越多，服务就越有价值，也越需要小心。
choices.why: 把原文的对比改成了正相关。

items.text: A town introduced free bicycles near its railway station. At first, officials expected commuters to use them mainly for work. Weekend use soon became just as common, suggesting that residents also valued the bicycles for shopping and leisure. The result was broader than the original plan.
items.prompt: 短文最后一句所说的“更广泛”主要指什么？

choices.label: 自行车不仅服务通勤，也进入购物和休闲场景
choices.why: 第二、三句展示了用途从工作扩展到周末生活。

choices.label: 铁路站被改建成了自行车商店
官员取消了最初的计划
choices.why: 结果超出计划，不等于计划被取消。
